protocol: Time-based split: the final 8 weeks of the 2011-2012 hourly series are the test window, scored once per candidate; the 8 weeks before it are validation (model selection, LightGBM HPO objective, MLP early stopping, ablation choice); everything earlier is training. Lag features read only the past. Paired bootstrap on the test window prices the champion-vs-floor MAE gap.
limits: The test window is scored once per candidate; model selection, early stopping and the ablation choice used validation only.
MAPE denominators are floored at 1 rental; near-zero hours inflate MAPE even when the absolute error is small — read MAE first.
Two seasons, one city, one system: transfer to other fleets or regimes is plausible, not measured.
